# pubflow

pubflow (“publishing workflow”) is the companion package of
[pipeflow](https://github.com/rpahl/pipeflow) (\>= 0.5.0.9028). pipeflow
computes; pubflow covers everything around a pipeline that is needed to
*publish* its results:

- **Parameters**: self-describing parameter objects with validity checks
  and configs;
- **Parameter UI**: a Shiny module that builds inputs from a pipeline’s
  parameters, with per-field validation;
- **Outputs and documents**: conventions for step outputs (tables,
  figures, Markdown text) and layout steps that arrange them into
  documents;
- **Viewer**: a Shiny module that shows a document as one scrollable
  page;
- **Reports**: HTML, Word (DOCX) and PDF via Pandoc, with traceability
  and DOCX post-processing.

## Status

Under development towards v0.1. The design is in
[dev/DESIGN.md](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/dev/DESIGN.md), the open
work in [dev/PLAN.md](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/dev/PLAN.md).

## Example

A step returns a table, a layout step arranges it into a document, and
[`pub_render()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_render.md)
writes the document to a Word file:

\
[`library`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/library.html)`(`[`pipeflow`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/)`)`\
[`library`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/library.html)`(`[`pubflow`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/)`)`\
\
`pip`` ``<-`` `[`pip_new`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pip_new.html)`(``"my-pip"``)`` ``|>`\
`    `[`pip_add`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pip_add.html)`(``"fit"``, ``function``(``data`` ``=`` ``airquality``, ``xVar`` ``=`` ``"Temp"``)`` ``{`\
`        ``coefs`` ``<-`` `[`coef`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/coef.html)`(`[`lm`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/lm.html)`(`[`paste`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/paste.html)`(``"Ozone ~"``, ``xVar``)``, data ``=`` ``data``)``)`\
`        `[`data.frame`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/data.frame.html)`(``term ``=`` `[`names`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/names.html)`(``coefs``)``, estimate ``=`` `[`unname`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/unname.html)`(``coefs``)``)`\
`    ``}``)`` ``|>`\
`    `[`pip_add`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pip_add.html)`(``"table"``, ``function``(``fit`` ``=`` ``~``fit``)`` ``{`\
`        `[`pub_table`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_table.md)`(``fit``, caption ``=`` ``"Linear model of the ozone concentration"``,`\
`                  digits ``=`` `[`c`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/c.html)`(``estimate ``=`` ``3L``)``)`\
`    ``}``)`` ``|>`\
`    `[`pip_add`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pip_add.html)`(``"report"``, ``function``(``table`` ``=`` ``~``table``)`` ``{`\
`        `[`pub_doc`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_doc.md)`(`[`pub_section`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_doc.md)`(``"Results"``, ``table``)``, title ``=`` ``"Ozone in New York"``)`\
`    ``}``)`\
[`pip_run`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pip_run.html)`(``pip``)`\
[`pub_render`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_render.md)`(``pip``[[``"report"``, ``"out"``]``]``, ``"docx"``)`

The vignette
[`vignette("v01-get-started", package = "pubflow")`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/articles/v01-get-started.md)
goes through the whole flow: params, outputs, documents, report files
and a Shiny app.

## Installation

\
`# install.packages("pak")`\
`pak``::`[`pak`](https://pak.r-lib.org/reference/pak.html)`(``"rpahl/pubflow"``)`

System requirements: pandoc \>= 3.6; for PDF output xelatex (default) or
typst. pubflow finds pandoc via the environment variable
`PUBFLOW_PANDOC`, then `RSTUDIO_PANDOC`, then the PATH; typst via
`PUBFLOW_TYPST`, then the PATH, then the typst bundled with Quarto. PDF
via xelatex needs the LaTeX packages of huxtable
([`huxtable::install_latex_dependencies()`](https://hughjonesd.github.io/huxtable/reference/report_latex_dependencies.html))
and pdflscape, fancyhdr, lastpage, float and newunicodechar (TinyTeX:
`tinytex::tlmgr_install(c("pdflscape", "fancyhdr", "lastpage", "float", "newunicodechar"))`);
pandoc finds xelatex on the PATH.

## Word reference documents

DOCX output uses pubflow’s reference document
(`inst/templates/reference.docx`, built by `data-raw/reference_docx.R`).
Its styles and the bookmarks of the header and footer lines that your
own reference document must provide are listed in
[`vignette("v06-reports", package = "pubflow")`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/articles/v06-reports.md).

## Development

The development library is managed with
[renv](https://rstudio.github.io/renv/) for R 4.5.3; start R in the
repository root and run `renv::restore()` once. R \>= 4.3 is supported
and checked on CI.

``` bash
R -q -e "devtools::document()"
R -q -e "devtools::test()"
R -q -e "pkgload::load_all(quiet = TRUE); lintr::lint_package()"
R -q -e "rcmdcheck::rcmdcheck(args = '--no-manual', error_on = 'warning', check_dir = 'check')"
```

# Package index

## Params: constructors

Create parameter objects and collect them into the config of a pipeline.

- [`param()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/param.md)
  [`numeric_param()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/param.md)
  [`numeral_param()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/param.md)
  [`choice_param()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/param.md)
  [`param_group()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/param.md)
  : Parameter objects
- [`param_config()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/param_config.md)
  [`c(`*`<param_config>`*`)`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/param_config.md)
  [`` `[`( ``*`<param_config>`*`)`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/param_config.md)
  : Parameter configs
- [`print(`*`<param_config>`*`)`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/print.param_config.md)
  : Print a param config

## Params: access

Test, read and set params.

- [`is_param()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/is_param.md)
  [`param_type()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/is_param.md)
  : Type and class of param objects
- [`param_value()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/param_value.md)
  [`` `param_value<-`() ``](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/param_value.md)
  : Get or set the value of a param
- [`param_attr()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/param_attr.md)
  : Retrieve an attribute of a param
- [`print(`*`<param>`*`)`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/print.param.md)
  : Print a param object

## Params: validity

Check param values and add validity rules.

- [`param_validity()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/param_validity.md)
  [`param_validity_assert()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/param_validity.md)
  [`add_validity()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/param_validity.md)
  [`default_param_validity()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/param_validity.md)
  : Validity checks of params

## Params: pipelines

Read the params of a pipeline and list them in a report.

- [`pub_get_params()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_get_params.md)
  : Get the param objects of a pipeline
- [`pub_params_table()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_params_table.md)
  : Table of parameters

## Shiny

Shiny modules for the parameter UI and the document viewer.

- [`pub_param_input()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_param_input.md)
  : Input widget for a param
- [`pub_params_ui()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_params_ui.md)
  [`pub_params_server()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_params_ui.md)
  [`pub_pipeline_params_server()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_params_ui.md)
  : Parameter UI module
- [`pub_viewer_ui()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_viewer_ui.md)
  [`pub_viewer_server()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_viewer_ui.md)
  : Document viewer (Shiny module)

## Document structure

Arrange step outputs into documents in layout steps.

- [`pub_doc()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_doc.md)
  [`pub_section()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_doc.md)
  : Documents and sections
- [`pub_layout_inputs()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_layout_inputs.md)
  : Inputs of a layout step: the steps of a view
- [`pub_out()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_out.md) :
  Output of a step that is up to date
- [`pub_pagebreak()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_pagebreak.md)
  [`pub_toc()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_pagebreak.md)
  [`pub_raw()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_pagebreak.md)
  : Page break, table of contents and raw content
- [`pub_session_info()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_session_info.md)
  : Session info section

## Outputs

Step outputs that documents show.

- [`pub_text()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_text.md)
  : Text output
- [`pub_figure()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_figure.md)
  : Figure output
- [`pub_type()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_type.md)
  : Type of an output
- [`as_pub_output()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/as_pub_output.md)
  : Convert an object into a supported output

## Metadata

Read and set the metadata of step outputs.

- [`pub_meta()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_meta.md)
  [`pub_set_meta()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_meta.md)
  [`` `pub_meta<-`() ``](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_meta.md)
  : Metadata of an output

## Tables

Build, style and display tables.

- [`pub_table()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_table.md)
  : Create a pubflow table
- [`pub_table_theme()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_table_theme.md)
  : Table theme
- [`pub_cell_text()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_cell_text.md)
  : Display text of table cells
- [`pub_strikeout()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_strikeout.md)
  : Strike table cells through

## Number formatting

Round and format numbers as GMP reports require.

- [`pub_round()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_round.md)
  [`pub_format_num()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_round.md)
  : Round numbers half away from zero

## Rendering

Render documents to HTML, Markdown and report files.

- [`pub_html()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_html.md)
  : Render a document to HTML
- [`pub_markdown()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_markdown.md)
  : Render a document to Pandoc Markdown
- [`pub_render()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_render.md)
  : Render a document to a file
- [`pub_cache()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_cache.md)
  : Define cache for figures and tables

## Report

Formats, pages, post-processors and traceability of reports.

- [`pub_report_spec()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_report_spec.md)
  [`pub_page()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_report_spec.md)
  : Report specs and pages
- [`pub_pp_docx_header_footer()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_pp_docx.md)
  [`pub_pp_docx_lock()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_pp_docx.md)
  : DOCX post-processors
- [`pub_trace_stamp()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_trace_stamp.md)
  : Trace stamp of a report
- [`pub_output_filename()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/reference/pub_output_filename.md)
  : File name of a rendered document

# Articles

### Get started

- [Get started with
  pubflow](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/articles/v01-get-started.md):

  Start here: from a pipeline with parameters to a document, a report
  file and a Shiny app.

### Building documents

Params, outputs and layout steps that build a document.

- [Parameters](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/articles/v02-parameters.md):

  Params in depth: constructors and validity rules, groups, configs,
  params in a pipeline, one value per name, a parameter table for
  documents and locked params.

- [Tables, figures and
  text](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/articles/v03-tables-figures-text.md):

  The outputs of a document: tables with pub_table() and huxtable,
  struck-through cells, rounding half away from zero, figures, Markdown
  texts, metadata and cross-references.

- [Documents and layout
  steps](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/articles/v04-documents.md):

  Build documents in pipeline steps: failed inputs, selecting the steps
  of a report by tags, layouts that change with the data, documents
  across pipelines and how to test layout steps.

### Shiny

Parameter UI and document viewer in an app.

- [Parameter UI and viewer in
  Shiny](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/articles/v05-shiny.md):

  Two Shiny modules turn a pipeline into an app: a parameter UI that
  checks every input and a viewer that shows the document. Invalid
  input, locked inputs, failed steps, running only the steps of the
  report shown, the render cache and Bootstrap 3 and 5.

### Reports

Report files in Word, PDF, HTML and Markdown.

- [Reports](https://rpahl.github.io/pubflow/articles/v06-reports.md):

  A report is a document written to a Word, PDF, HTML or Markdown file.
  Render-time metadata, the trace stamp and file names, report specs for
  each format, error items, the Word header, footer and locks, Word
  reference documents, and the setup of LaTeX and Typst.
